'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Craig Teppert DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Craig Teppert]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Craig Teppen
* '''Deck name:''' Jerry Sucks
* '''Username:''' MrGoofball
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
